verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a documented public REST API with configuration-driven access token auth, and runtime probes confirm the hosted API is live and properly OAuth-gated (401 with auth metadata) rather than absent or broken. This is complemented by a Terraform provider and PyAirbyte SDK for programmatic/AI-native control, giving multiple documented paths to drive Airbyte programmatically. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at the docs domain (probe found 404s on standard paths), so full spec-level self-discovery isn't independently verified.
